description: Unique synthetic resume record identifier. It does not identify a real person.
Target job family associated with the resume feature vector. Ten role categories are represented.
Synthetic years of relevant professional experience; bounded from 0 to 15 years.
Count of job-description skills matched to the resume, on a synthetic scale from 3 to 15.
Synthetic education-fit score on a 0-100 scale, restricted here to 60-100. It is a proxy feature, not a judgement of a real person.
Fraction of relevant keywords found in the resume text representation; bounded between 0.100 and 0.900.
Simulated overall fit score (0-100). For the 4,500 generated rows it follows a documented weighted feature recipe plus random variation; it is not a validated production prediction.
Synthetic target label: 1 indicates shortlisted and 0 indicates not shortlisted. The original 500 labels are preserved; 3% of added rows contain controlled label noise for robustness testing.
